name: discuss_collect
description: Gather the current round's member replies from the host inbox (waits up to timeout_secs for all members, returns early when everyone replied). Inactive members are woken headlessly by default. Replies are recorded in the room transcript.

timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for replies (default 60, clamped 5-600). Blocks this long only when members are slow.

wake.description: Wake inactive members headlessly before waiting (default true).
